evals.name: Promote an unlocked intent to Ready
evals.prompt: Use the intent-promote skill to promote the intent 'label-reprint'. Facts: its card is in Create, and central/ has no lock for it. In this environment the intents root is intents-root/ (not ~/Documents/intents). intents-root/repo stands in for main of the PM repo the-marmack/intent-themarmack, and central/ stands in for main of the-marmack/intents: a file there exists on main, and a file missing there is missing on main. GitHub, git and Word conversion tools are unavailable, so don't call gh: skip step 2's lookups (facts below), treat step 4's sync as 'no changes', and instead of running a command that changes something on GitHub, append it to commands.md, one per line. Write what you tell the PM to promote-report.md. Even if the skill tells you to stop, write the report file before you finish.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill
expectations: The card moves to Ready and the issue gets a 'Promoted' comment.
The report says a change after planning starts needs a new intent that supersedes it.

In this environment the intents root is intents-root/ (not ~/Documents/intents). intents-root/repo stands in for main of the PM repo the-marmack/intent-themarmack, and central/ stands in for main of the-marmack/intents: a file there exists on main, and a file missing there is missing on main. GitHub, git and Word conversion tools are unavailable, so don't call gh: skip step 2's lookups (facts below), treat step 4's sync as 'no changes', and instead of running a command that changes something on GitHub, append it to commands.md, one per line. Write what you tell the PM to promote-report.md. Even if the skill tells you to stop, write the report file before you finish.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill
expectations: The report says the intent is already promoted and locked, and that a change needs a new intent that supersedes it; nothing is changed.
